implementation: Use64-byte K16 rows containing eight lossless per-pair core FP16 values, original unit exponents and exact low-byte residues. Each supported normal BF16 pair has exponent spread<=7; unsupported pairs retain both original BF16 encodings. Original paired maxima determine the common carry exponent. For eligible shifts[-11,8], recover the exact core integer sum conditionally from native zero-C FP16 DOT2 and IU8 residue; remove individual signed remainders before positive shifts. Unsupported/range/midpoint cases use original BF16 products. The same four-lane modulo reduction, carry alignment, normalization and ascending K16 order remain intact. No runtime dispatcher changes.
correctness_scope: All metadata words roundtrip, generated host/native ordered carries agree with the original wide CPU primitive, all native production/audit variants agree, and every captured original raw endpoint and GB10 BF16 cell passes each warmup/timed attempt. Capture audits count all candidate pairs and independently compare256 complete original carry chains per operator. The separately characterized native recovery assumption remains conditional; finite tests do not establish a universal hardware bound. q8192 captures repeat1023 rows after the original7169; references are comparison-only.
timing_scope: Five configurations rotate across one warmup and three completed host samples. Both full operand preparations and every bounded262144-candidate replay dispatch are inside clocks. Common matrix production, L2, selection, allocation, resets, all validation and separate audits are outside. New metadata64 bytes versus original36 is fully prepared inside each timed attempt. QKV explicitly uses retained algorithm4 and the original adjacent-midpoint candidate predicate; OUT algorithm0 exercises generic correction, not the retained coarse OUT owner. No model load, TTFT, decode or product gain is inferred.

decision.decision: Keep the new paired representation and recovery isolated. Every captured original raw endpoint and GB10 BF16 output passes, but all four staging variants regress on both QKV and OUT. Best QKV96.8593ms versus42.9067ms and OUT375.922ms versus160.019ms do not justify a product integration or model run. High recovered-pair coverage and fewer standalone VGPRs do not establish lower total cost. Retain the qualified product control; pursue a broader execution route.
